title: Track B (dynamic TP / SL): the TP x SL grid, volatility-scaled exits, time-series momentum for large brackets, a calibrated model per bracket, and every trigger family per bracket
status: APPROVED by the operator 2026-11-08; written and committed before any of its code; research only, isolated branch
approval: Operator, 2026-11-08 (chat, Phase C): "TRACK B - DYNAMIC TP/SL DISCOVERY ... Register the full experiment space before execution ... Identify the best strategy by net expectancy and risk-adjusted performance, not by highest historical win rate."
unsealed_data_also_used: 2026 (from 2026-01-01, scored from 2026-03-01) and the live store's 5m bars (Sep-Nov 2026), only to CHECK frozen candidates and the 15m resolution bounds; validation and holdout are not read
trade: B26's execution model with TP != SL: decision at a 15m close, fill at the next open (BUY at the ask, SELL at the bid, plus entry slippage); TP = fill +- TP*k, SL = fill -+ SL*k (k = price / 4000 in development, 1 in 2026); a BUY's levels trigger on the bid, a SELL's on the ask; a bar opening beyond the stop fills at the open less slippage, beyond the target at the target; a bar reaching both levels is AMBIGUOUS; 192 bars (2 trading days) at most; closure exits; ENG costs primary, GROSS / OP / ADV beside
resolution: Every rate is reported twice: worst case (AMBIGUOUS = stop, the primary) and best case (AMBIGUOUS = target). The truth lies between them. Where the gap exceeds 2 points the 15m result is marked INCONCLUSIVE and the 5m store window is the check.
theory: p0 = (SL - delta) / (TP + SL), delta = spread + entry slippage; break-even p* = (SL + slip_out + commission) / (TP + SL + slip_out); reported beside every measured rate (PHASE_C_PLAN.md section 2)

studies.G_grid: TP in {3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 18, 20, 25, 30} x SL in the same set (100 pairs) plus TP 8 / SL 10: 101 pairs. Entries at every eligible bar, BUY and SELL separately. Descriptive: the measured geometry against theory, per pair, with costs; no pass / fail.
studies.V_atr: TP = a x ATR14 and SL = b x ATR14 (15m, at the decision bar), a and b in {0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3}: 25 pairs, every eligible bar. H0: volatility scaling does not raise expectancy per unit risk over the fixed-dollar pair with the closest median size.
studies.M_tsmom: Direction = the sign of the change of the New York session daily close over the last 20 (and, separately, 60) completed days (Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen 2012). Entries at every 16th eligible decision (4 hours apart) in that direction. Brackets {20/20, 25/15, 25/25, 30/20, 30/30, 20/10, 30/15}. Primary baseline: direction-neutral random (the mean of BUY and SELL in the same session and month), because a same-direction same-month baseline already contains the drift being predicted; the same-direction baseline is reported beside it.
studies.C_model: Brackets {5/10, 10/10, 10/15, 15/10, 20/10, 20/20, 30/20}: LightGBM (pooled, direction as a feature) on B27's features plus the HMM, labels = TP first under that bracket (worst case), the quarterly purged walk-forward of B27 (first test quarter 2021-01, 1-day embargo, isotonic calibration on the last 20% of each training window); top q in {50, 20, 10, 5, 2, 1}% by the training window's own threshold; AUC, Brier vs the constant forecast, reliability.
studies.E_triggers: The 21 trigger families (B27's 13 and B28's 8) with immediate entry, each in its own direction, under the 7 brackets of C_model.

statistics: Decided TP-first rate (worst case primary) on the independent series with a Wilson interval; SL-first and neither shares; matched random of the same bracket, direction, session and month (M: direction-neutral); one-sided exact binomial; BH q = 0.05 within V, M, C and E separately; expectancy per oz and per 0.50 lot (ASSUMED 100 oz), expectancy per unit of risk (net / SL), profit factor, maximum drawdown and its Monte Carlo 95th percentile, longest losing run, minutes to TP and to SL, trades per week, monthly results (share of profitable months), results by volatility tercile / trend / session, cost sensitivity (GROSS / OP / ENG / ADV)
tiers: INFORMATIVE: BH-significant, lower bound above matched random, >= 300 independent trades. TRADEABLE: also lower bound above that bracket's break-even and positive ENG expectancy.
frozen_for_2026: Per study (V, M, C, E): every INFORMATIVE configuration (at most 20), the 5 best by development lower bound with >= 300 trades and the 5 best with 30-299; G: the 5 pairs with the best expectancy per unit risk; checked on 2026 (Holm across all frozen)
leaderboards: B: Track B frozen candidates. C: the best risk-adjusted across Tracks A (B27 + B28) and B, ranked by development expectancy per unit risk, then lower bound; Track A's leaderboard is kept separate. Each names the best high-probability, net-profit, risk-adjusted, low-drawdown, BUY, SELL and 5m-execution setups, with 'none qualifies' where none does.
decision: None here. A TRADEABLE candidate that holds on 2026 is proposed as one hypothesis for the sealed validation period (operator approval). The report states the highest defensible TP-first rate for each bracket and its gap to 90%.
